messages:
alex: hey team — small rename in my PR #3428 caused CI to fail: pyright + pre-commit (rustfmt). not sure why only Linux runners fail. cc @maya @sam
ci-bot: build/pr-3428 — lint — FAILED :x:
alex: pyright error: `reportMissingImports: Cannot find module 'redwood.kv_cache' (imported as 'redwood.kvcache')`
alex: repro steps:
```bash
git fetch origin pull/3428/head:pr-3428
git checkout pr-3428
poetry install
poetry run pyright --project pyrightconfig.json
pre-commit run --all-files
```
sam: rustfmt fail shows eng-runtime/src/native_bindings.rs had import ordering changes — smells like rustfmt version drift between CI and local dev
alex: small diff causing the formatting bit:
```diff
- use std::sync::Arc;
- use anyhow::Result;
+ use anyhow::Result;
+ use std::sync::Arc;
```
maya: hmm — CI image is on rustfmt 1.75, our devs still on 1.73. we should either pin rustfmt in CI or ensure the job installs the exact toolchain (rustup component add rustfmt).
sam: short-term: can we just rerun the lint job after alex pushes the tiny import-order fix? @ci-bot can you rerun lint for build/pr-3428 please?
ci-bot: Re-run requested by sam — queued lint job (build/pr-3428, job=lint). ETA ~3m :gear:
ci-bot: lint — PASSED :white_check_mark:
alex: ok lint passed after the formatting tweak, but pyright is still the blocker — anyone able to run pyright in an env that matches CI (python 3.11 + dev deps)?
maya: i can. spinning up a container now to match the runner. will post output in a sec. :coffee:
maya: confirmed — pyright still errors. looks like the import rename changed package layout and CI's path mapping doesn't pick up the new module name. local pyright is stricter when run as the CI user.
maya: quick options: 1) tweak pyright config to add an extra path mapping, 2) revert the rename and do the rename in a dedicated migration PR. i vote revert for safety.
alex: makes sense — i'll open a follow-up PR reverting the rename and include a migration note, plus a tiny test to catch the import path. for now please hold off on merging #3428. :pray:
sam: ack. once the revert PR is up i'll approve a rerun and we can merge both in order. thanks for the quick triage everyone. :thumbsup:
alex: filing the revert PR now, will link it in a minute.
